subject: Video shoot plan & release forms for Acme Health testimonial
messages:
From: Ari Solomon <ari@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — customer reference + video

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team at Acme Health is excited about what Redwood has enabled for our intake triage ML flows. We talked internally and would be happy to do a short on-camera testimonial to highlight throughput gains and cost savings.

A few constraints from our side: we prefer a 20–30 minute shoot, we need to record on-site at our SF office (we have a small campus studio), and we need to sign a release ahead of the shoot. Would next Tuesday (Mar 9) or Thursday (Mar 11) work for Redwood/the production partner?

I can loop in Claire from BrightFrame (who handled our product videos last year) for production logistics.

Best,
Ari
Ari Solomon | VP Product, Acme Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Solomon <ari@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — customer reference + video

Hi Ari — great news, thank you.

We can absolutely support an on-site shoot. Quick responses to your bullets:
- 20–30 minutes on camera is perfect for a short testimonial. We typically plan a 60–90 minute window on-site to allow for setup, b-roll, and to avoid rushing you.
- Mar 9/11 — both currently look ok on our side; Rishi will confirm availability for the shoot lead.
- We will circulate a draft release and a short interview script / talking points for your approval.

Laura, can you coordinate the scheduling with Ari and send the calendar invite? Rishi, I’m copying you to prep the tech talking points (metrics we should highlight: throughput increase, latency improvement, cost per token reduction, rollout timeline). Vivek — quick ask: can you prepare a one-slide summary with the before/after numbers (for Ari to sign off)?

I’ll also loop in our legal contact for the release form.

Thanks — excited to make this easy.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ari Solomon <ari@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — customer reference + video

Thanks Marissa — Ari, quick note on content so the shoot is tight and useful for product and sales collateral:

Suggested outline for the ~3 questions (we'll keep them conversational):
1) Brief intro (name, role, what Acme Health does) — 20–30s
2) Challenge before Redwood (what bottlenecks you had, approx. latency/throughput pain) — 45–60s
3) What changed after deploying Redwood (numbers + example flow) — 60–90s
4) Business impact / outcome (ops time saved, revenue impact, regulatory positives) — 30–45s
5) Closing endorsement / recommendation — 15–30s

Technical talking points we want to highlight (feel free to edit):
- End-to-end latency reduced by ~40% on peak flows
- Average cost per 1k tokens down by ~25% after batching + KV cache
- We used dedicated capacity (pinned model v1.3.2) with automatic fallback to v1.2.0 during peak maintenance windows

If any of those numbers are rough, Ari and Vivek, please correct.

Logistics note: I suggest we block 90 minutes on-site and ask BrightFrame to bring a lav mic for the subject and a spare laptop for a quick screen capture.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Park <claire@brightframe.tv>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ari Solomon <ari@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — customer reference + video

Hi all — Claire here (producer, BrightFrame). Thanks for the ping — we can take the shoot. Attached is a short shot list and a proposed half-day schedule. Summary:
- Shoot day: Mar 11, 2026 (preferred) — arrive 09:00 PT, wrap by 13:00 PT.
- On-camera interview + cutaways for product UI + office b-roll.
- Crew: 2-person (producer + camera/lighting), lav mic + shotgun, small LED kit.

We’ll bring a draft script and pre-interview questions to keep Ari comfortable on camera. We can also do a quick 20-minute remote pre-brief the week before (script read-through).

Attachment: shot_list_brightframe.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Logistics ask for Ari/Acme: power access for lighting, a quiet conference room with a plain wall or branded background, and a point of contact for access and parking.

Happy to jump on a 15-minute call if we should run the schedule by anyone.

— Claire
Claire Park | Producer, BrightFrame Studios
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Hi Ari / team — attaching our standard release for customer testimonials. Key points for Acme to note:
- We require a signed talent & location release that grants Redwood and its partners the right to use the footage in marketing channels (website, presentations, social) in perpetuity.
- We can add a clause limiting usage to specific regions/channels on request — please flag if you need limitations.
- We will not share raw footage externally without separate consent.

Attachment: redwood_release_draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

A small edit request from legal: if Acme wants to approve the final cut before distribution, we can add a one-time review window (5 business days) — let us know.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen | Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
